game.name: R.E.P.O.
game.rules:
Rules written in "**bold**" are the most important ones that are to be respected, if not, your run will be instantly rejected. *Italic* ones are the one that will give you relatively important infos.

>  **LiveSplit and the Auto Splitter are both required and will need to be entirely visible and unobstructed for the whole duration of the video proof. Only applies to the host in case of co-op runs.**

> **All POVs must be provided for co-op runs.**

---

# 1/ Gameplay

1- **Any use of cheat, external rebinding, mods or macros/sensitivity inscreasing macros (basically any 3rd parties softwares other than timers or crosshairs) such as trainers (during the run), is strictly forbidden and any run using it will be rejected.**

---

# 2/ General Glitches and Restrictions

| *Some of these restrictions may be authorized in one or multiple categories so, please also check the categories rules to make sure that you are submitting to the right category.*

1- *Shopscumming* / Save reloading in order to have a better shop rng is not allowed.

---

# 3/ Timer

1- **LiveSplit and the Auto Splitter are both required and will need to be entirely visible and  unobstructed for the whole duration of the video proof. Only applies to the host in case of co-op runs.**

2- *Timer starts and stops depending on the category rules.*

3- *Co-op runs are timed based on the host's POV*

---

# 4/ Video Proof

1- **Permanent video proof of the run is required and have to be uploaded on Youtube, BiliBili, Twitch, Kick or by Google Drive.**

2- **Moderators will have all rights to reject your run if they consider it to have a quality that's too low.**

3- **In-game audio is required.**

4- **For Co-Op runs, at least one player will have to start recording in the game lobby or before to be sure of who the host is.**

---

# **5/ Submissions**

1- **All POVs must be provided for co-op runs.**

2- Please to only one of the two subcategories, don't submit in both *Any%* & *Glitchless.*

categories.rules:
# 1 | 1 LEVEL

Complete the *first level* as fast as possible by collecting enough money for the tax.

### Timing:

Timer **starts** when the HUD starts appearing after the level loading screen.

Timer ***ends*** with the black screen appearing after leaving with the truck at the end of *LEVEL 1.*

*We'll use the Auto Splitter in order to time the run precisely and with no mistakes, please make sure to have it enabled for your submissions.*
